preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and n % 2 == 0 and 2 <= n <= 100
preconditions.description: n is an even integer between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s)
preconditions.description: s is a string of length n consisting only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(b, list) and len(b) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 100 for x in b)
preconditions.description: b is a list of n integers, each between 1 and 100 inclusive.
It is guaranteed that the characters of s can be reordered to form an antipalindromic string.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout, str) and stdout.strip().isdigit() and int(stdout.strip()) == max_beauty
postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum possible beauty.

postconditions.expression: max_beauty == max(sum(b[i] for i in range(n) if t[i] == s[i]) for t in antipalindromic_permutations(s))
postconditions.description: The output value equals the maximum sum of beauties b[i] over all indices i where the character in the antipalindromic permutation t matches s[i], maximized over all valid antipalindromic permutations t of s.
